expectations.text: The reset is an evaluation-only option that is off by default, and training/rollout collection is unchanged.
expectations.evidence: junction_reset_rollouts is evaluation-only; reset_at_junction flag; training untouched.

expectations.text: Only the envs that just entered the junction get their recurrent state zeroed (a per-env mask), and each env is reset once per episode, not every step it spends in the junction.
expectations.evidence: done = done | entered, once per episode; the test checks the flag rises exactly once.

expectations.text: The junction region is derived from the room JSON or twin-room generator geometry so it works for every L, not hard-coded coordinates for a single room.
expectations.evidence: junction_region added to the generator and all twin_rooms_L*.json; read by junction_region_json().

expectations.text: The new path is actually run (test or smoke evaluation) for both an LSTM and a GRU agent.
expectations.evidence: Tests test_reset_at_junction_zeroes_state_once[lstm|gru]; script run end to end on untrained LSTM and GRU checkpoints.

expectations.text: No git commit or push is made.
expectations.evidence: Only the harness snapshot commit in git log.
